title: Ever Works — App spec (.works/works.yml, kind: app)
description: appSpecVersion 1 inside the works.yml envelope. Conventions follow packages/agent/src/works-config/schema/emit-json-schema.ts (draft 2020-12, published under $id https://api.ever.works/api/schema/…, byte-reproducible serialization). Unlike the envelope, every object INSIDE `spec` is strict: a key this schema does not define is error `unknown_field`, except keys starting with `x-`, which are allowed at any depth and preserved. The platform never deletes a key it does not recognise (CONTRACTS.md C1); strictness changes the validation result only. JSON Schema cannot express the reference grammar's resolution, secrecy/phase propagation, cycle detection or the server-only rules — see docs/specs/features/app-works/_build-artifacts/apw-03-schema/validator-rules.md for the rule-to-layer map.

version.description: Envelope schema version. Advisory, never gating: a newer value is a warning, not an error (works-config.schema.ts:21-25).

kind.description: `app`. When absent, `spec.kind: app` selects this schema; when both are present they must be equal, else error `kind_mismatch`.

name.description: v1 root key, unchanged. `display.name` wins when both are present.

spec.description: The App spec (schema.md §4-§22). Validated strictly: unknown keys are errors, `x-` keys are allowed at any depth. `source` is required here — that is the data-repository reading of schema.md §4; a Blueprint validates against #/$defs/appSpec directly, because §3 forbids `source` in `blueprint` mode.

extensionKeys.description: Extension keys: any key starting with `x-` is allowed at any depth inside `spec`, preserved and ignored (schema.md §2.3 / CONTRACTS.md C1).

envEntryName.description: `env[].name`: an EnvName that is not in the reserved `EVER_WORKS_` prefix (schema.md R23, error `reserved_env_name`). The prefix is reserved for platform-injected values.

relPath.description: Repository-relative path, 1-255 characters: no leading `/`, no backslash, no `..` segment, not under `.git/` (schema.md §0, rule R22 / error `path_outside_repository`).

glob.description: A RelPath that may contain `*`, `**` or `?`, 1-200 characters (schema.md §0).

gitRef.description: Git ref name, 1-255 characters, not ending `.lock`, containing `..` or `//` (schema.md §5).

cronExpression.description: Five-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, UTC (schema.md §0). This pattern fixes the FIELD COUNT only; whether each field parses is rule `cron_invalid` (validator-rules.md §2).

cpuQuantity.description: Millicores (`250m`) or cores (`2`, `0.5`) (schema.md §0). The 10m-64000m / 0.01-64 range is rule `out_of_range` (validator-rules.md §2): JSON Schema cannot compare a magnitude across unit spellings.

memQuantity.description: Integer followed by `Mi` or `Gi` (schema.md §0). The per-field range is rule `out_of_range` (validator-rules.md §2).

storageQuantity.description: Integer followed by `Mi` or `Gi`, range 100Mi-500Gi (schema.md §0). The range is rule `out_of_range` (validator-rules.md §2).

imageRef.description: `registry/path[:tag][@sha256:<64 hex>]`, at most 512 characters (schema.md §0). A tag-only reference is warning `image_not_pinned` (R19), not an error.

reference.description: A `from:` reference (schema.md §21): domains.primary.url|host, build.commitSha, components.<name>.internalUrl, deps.<postgres|redis|objectStorage|smtp>.<output> (including deps.objectStorage.bucket.<name>), platform.smtp.<host|port|user|password|from|secure>. Whether the reference RESOLVES is rule `reference_unresolved` (validator-rules.md §2).

appSpec.description: The `spec` block of a `.works/works.yml` whose kind is `app` (schema.md §4). Every object inside is strict; `x-` keys are allowed at any depth (CONTRACTS.md C1). This definition deliberately does NOT require `source`: the data-repository reading requires it (the root schema applies that), while schema.md §3 forbids `source` in `blueprint` mode and a Blueprint validates against this definition alone.

kind.description: Optional; repeats the root kind. Must equal the root `kind` when both are present (error `kind_mismatch`; JSON Schema rejects a non-`app` value here, the equality check itself is rule `kind_mismatch`).

appSpecVersion.description: App spec version, 1-1000, default 1 (schema.md §1, CONTRACTS.md C1). A value newer than the build understands turns `unknown_field` errors into warnings `unknown_field_newer_version`; every other rule still applies.

components.description: At most 10, at least 1 when build.strategy is not `none` (R2 / `strategy_requires_components`).

env.description: Every variable the app reads. At most 200 entries; names unique, counting the implicit `<NAME>_PUBLIC` of a keypair entry (R4 / `duplicate_name`).

jobs.description: Run as cluster Jobs. At most 10; names unique (R4).

cron.description: The app's own recurring calls, rendered as cluster CronJobs. At most 20; names unique (R4).

smoke.description: Run after every Deployment. At most 20; names unique (R4).

checks.description: Quality gates for Tasks on this App Work. At most 20; names unique (R4).

allOf.description: R2 — `build.strategy` other than `none` requires at least one component (`strategy_requires_components`).
R2 — components require `build.strategy` to be declared (`components_require_strategy`).

source.description: §5 — how the Work Repository relates to the upstream. Written by APW-01 at creation; on the Blueprint path by APW-03's apply job (R-4).

upstream.description: Absent when relation is `link`; required otherwise.

branch.description: The Work Repository branch that is built and deployed. Git ref name.

allOf.description: §5 — `upstream` is required unless the relation is `link`, and forbidden when it is (`upstream_forbidden_for_link`).

blueprint.description: §6 — written by the platform when an App Blueprint is applied; informational afterwards.

id.description: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$`. An id the Apps catalog does not list is warning `blueprint_unknown` (server-only).

version.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (schema.md §6). Whether a pre-release suffix is allowed is an open question — see gaps-and-contradictions.md.

license.description: §7 — informational. The license gate classifies from DETECTION, never from this block; a declared value that differs from detection is warning `license_declared_mismatch` (server-only).

spdx.description: SPDX expression, at most 200 characters (`MIT`, `AGPL-3.0-only`, `MIT OR Apache-2.0`, `LicenseRef-<id>`). Expression validity is checked by the platform's SPDX parser, not by JSON Schema.

notice.description: Trademark / attribution notice shown with the app, at most 500 characters.

sourceOfferUrl.description: Where network users obtain the source when the Work Repository is private (CONTRACTS.md C2). `https://` URL, at most 500 characters.

name.description: 1-80 characters; the Work name when absent.

protectedPaths.description: At most 50 globs. Agents may not change matching files (D13; enforced by APW-08).

strategy.description: `dockerfile` builds the named Dockerfile; `image` deploys a prebuilt image and runs no Build; `none` builds and runs nothing; `auto` is a zero-config build (R-13). Default `none` when `components` is empty.

dockerfile.description: Only with `strategy: dockerfile` (error `unknown_field`-adjacent: this schema reports it as a failed `not`; the platform reports it as a misplaced key — see validator-rules.md §3).

image.description: Required with `strategy: image`; a tag-only reference is warning `image_not_pinned` (R19).

args.description: Build-time values; at most 50. Each entry names exactly one of `value` / `fromEnv` (error `env_source_count`-style count rule; code `env_source_count` is for `env[]`, build args report the same shape). Reference env names, never literal secrets (R10 / `literal_secret_in_build_args`; R11 warning `secret_build_arg`).

services.description: Ephemeral services reachable only during the build; at most 5.

resources.description: Build runner resources. CPU is a plain number of cores here, unlike component resources.

allOf.description: §9 — `dockerfile` and `target` are only meaningful with `strategy: dockerfile`; `context` only with `dockerfile` or `auto`.

buildArg.description: §9 — `{ name, value }` or `{ name, fromEnv }`, exactly one of the two.

fromEnv.description: Names an entry of `env` with phase `build` or `both` (errors `reference_unresolved` / `phase_mismatch`). Naming a secret entry is warning `secret_build_arg` (R11).

component.description: §10 — APW-06. A `web` component gets a Service and an Ingress; a `worker` gets neither.

command.description: At most 20 items, each at most 1000 characters. Image entrypoint when absent.

args.description: At most 50 items, each at most 1000 characters. Image cmd when absent.

target.description: Dockerfile stage override for this component.

replicas.description: 0-10, default 1. A component with `volumes` may not have more than one replica (R18 / `volume_replicas`).

memoryLimit.description: Must be at least `memory` (R17 / `limit_below_request`); defaults to twice `memory`.

volumes.description: At most 5; names and paths unique (R4 / `duplicate_name`).

allOf.description: R18 — a component with `volumes` and `replicas > 1` (`volume_replicas`): a volume cannot attach to two pods.

probe.description: §10 — exactly one of `http: HttpPath` or `tcp: true`.

volume.description: §10 — `{ name, path, size, backup }`; `backup` defaults to true.

path.description: Absolute in-container path, at most 255 characters.

dependencies.description: §11 — APW-07. Outputs a `from:` may reference are in schema.md §11; the normative list is APW-07's APP_DEPENDENCY_OUTPUTS.

directUrl.description: Also provide a non-pooled URL. `deps.postgres.directUrl` resolves only when this is true.

buckets.description: Required, 1-10, unique. Each name is a `deps.objectStorage.bucket.<name>` reference target (CONTRACTS.md C2).

publicBuckets.description: Must be a subset of `buckets` (error `public_bucket_undeclared`) — a subset check over a dynamic list, so rule-level (validator-rules.md §2).

required.description: `true` blocks the deploy until SMTP is configured (APW-07).

envEntry.description: §12 — APW-07. Exactly one value source (R7 / `env_source_count`); a `secret: true` entry may not carry `value` (R8 / `literal_secret_value`); `generate` implies `secret: true` (`generated_not_secret`).

secret.description: Stored encrypted, never logged or returned (Constitution VII).

template.description: At most 2048 characters. `{{…}}` placeholders over the §21 references plus `env.<NAME>`; placeholder syntax is rule `reference_syntax` (validator-rules.md §2).

generate.description: §12 — generated values are produced once per App Work and never regenerated unless the user explicitly rotates them.

keypair.description: §12 / R-11 — the private half is stored in the entry itself, the public half is exposed as `<NAME>_PUBLIC` only.

passwordEnv.description: Names another `env` entry that is `secret: true` and generated with `kind` `base64`, `hex` or `chars` (R26 / `keypair_password_invalid`).

allOf.description: R26 — `passwordEnv` is present exactly when `format: pkcs12` (`keypair_password_invalid`).

envValidate.description: §12 — what a supplied value must satisfy. `minLength <= maxLength` and agreement with `generate` are rules R9 / `generate_validate_conflict` (validator-rules.md §2).

pattern.description: At most 500 characters. RE2 syntax: no back-references and no look-around, else error `pattern_unsupported`. JSON Schema cannot check RE2 compatibility, so this is rule-level.

envPrompt.description: §12 — asked at creation when the entry has no other source.

when.description: `first-deploy` jobs run before the app is exposed publicly.

component.description: Must name a component (`component_ref_unknown`); defaults to `domains.primaryComponent`. An `http` job needs a `web` component (`http_job_requires_web_component`).

command.description: At most 20 items, each at most 1000 characters.

jobHttp.description: §13 — sent to the component's port inside the cluster, never through the public URL.

body.description: JSON, at most 16 KiB serialized. String leaves may contain `{{…}}` placeholders (§21); the outline's `generatedCredential: admin` is a placeholder — write `{{env.ADMIN_PASSWORD}}` over a generated env entry (CONTRACTS.md C2). The 16 KiB cap is rule-level.

authScheme.description: `bearer` (default) sends `Authorization: Bearer <value>`; `raw` sends `Authorization: <value>`. Only with `authEnv` (CONTRACTS.md C2, APW-13 addition). Applies to jobs and cron alike.

status.description: 1-10 codes, 100-599. Default [200, 201, 204]. Smoke requests never follow redirects, so this sees the first response.

cron.description: §14 — the app's own recurring calls, rendered as cluster CronJobs; not platform Schedules. `http` is as in §13, including `authEnv` and `authScheme`.

component.description: Defaults to `domains.primaryComponent`; must name a component (`component_ref_unknown`).

primaryComponent.description: Must name a `web` component (R3 / `primary_component_invalid`); required with two or more `web` components.

publicUrlEnv.description: At most 10; each names an `env` entry (R16 / `reference_unresolved`).

needsHairpin.description: The app calls its own public URL from the server side.

smoke.description: §16 — APW-06. Smoke requests never follow redirects, so `expect.status` judges the first response (CONTRACTS.md §1).

body.description: JSON, at most 16 KiB, `POST` only. The cap and the method pairing are rule-level.

check.description: §17 — APW-08. Quality gates for Tasks on this App Work; run sandboxed. `name` is the provider check name suffix `Ever Works check: {name}` in the repository's CI (R-9).

command.description: 1-500 characters, at least one non-whitespace character, no control characters.

required.description: `false` is warning `advisory_check` — an advisory check verifies nothing (R20).

requireHumanMergePaths.description: At most 50 globs — paths whose changes only a person may merge, whatever the merge policy says (CONTRACTS.md §1, APW-08 addition; schema owned by APW-03).

schedule.description: Default `0 6 * * 1`. Consecutive fires at least 60 minutes apart (R21 / `schedule_too_frequent`) — rule-level.

requireApproval.description: Only `true` is valid (R12 / `upstream_pr_approval_required`) — cannot be set false.

provisioning.description: §20 — APW-04 addition (CONTRACTS.md §1). The App Provisioner never writes it and always preserves it.

autoReprovision.description: Default false. The owner's opt-in to automatic re-provisioning when an upstream sync breaks the smoke tests.
